name: Cam Vinh
summary: Cam Vinh is the fruit Cục Du lịch Quốc gia Việt Nam names beside cháo lươn. The city portal’s eight-specialty article calls it cam Xã Đoài, grown in a small area of xã Nghi Diên, huyện Nghi Lộc, and says people call it cam tiến Vua. A harvest month was not printed.
origin: The national page and the city introduction say cam Vinh. The eight-specialty article places the orchard in Nghi Diên, Nghi Lộc. Both stay.
taste: The city portal’s eight-specialty article says a cut fruit is gently sweet and fragrant, and that a scuffed skin gives off a smell of its own.
howToEat: Eat it as the fruit. The eight-specialty article says a new-ripe fruit is yellow, then darker, still fresh-looking, with a thin skin that smells when it is scuffed, and that a cut fruit is gently sweet and fragrant. A drink recipe was not on these pages. A harvest month was not printed. Check on arrival.

The city food-culture page says Sách Kỷ lục Việt Nam put cam Vinh in a top 50 of fruit. That is the city portal’s wording. The city portal also names xoài Tương Dương, dứa Quỳnh Lưu, ổi Nghĩa Đàn, and chanh leo Quế Phong. Those are other districts. They are not this fruit.
where: Buy it in the city. An orchard street in Vinh was not named. The eight-specialty article places the trees in Nghi Diên, Nghi Lộc. A shop is not named. A price is Check on arrival.
